input.command:
cd /tmp/opencode/bench/log-analysis-kernel && python3 -c "
import re,json
from collections import Counter
pat=re.compile(r'^(\S+) (\w+) user=(\S+) route=(\S+) code=(\S+) latency=(\d+)ms msg=\"(.*)\"$')
rows=[pat.match(l).groups() for l in open('server.log').read().splitlines()]
print('levels',Counter(r[1] for r in rows))
errs=[r for r in rows if r[1]=='ERROR']
print('error count',len(errs))
print('codes',Counter(r[4] for r in errs).most_common(5))
co=[int(r[5]) for r in rows if r[3]=='/api/checkout']
print('checkout n',len(co),'mean',sum(co)/len(co))
to=[r for r in rows if 'timeout' in r[6]]
print('timeout n',len(to),'users',len(set(r[2] for r in to)))
fat=[r for r in rows if r[1]=='FATAL']
print('fatal n',len(fat),'first',fat[0][0] if fat else None)
"

input.command:
cd /tmp/opencode/bench/log-analysis-kernel && python3 -c "
import re,json
from collections import Counter
pat=re.compile(r'^(\S+) (\w+) user=(\S+) route=(\S+) code=(\S+) latency=(\d+)ms msg=\"(.*)\"$')
rows=[pat.match(l).groups() for l in open('server.log').read().splitlines()]
print(Counter(r[6] for r in rows if 'timeout' in r[6].lower()))
print('timeout users ci',len(set(r[2] for r in rows if 'timeout' in r[6].lower())))
print('min fatal ts',min(r[0] for r in rows if r[1]=='FATAL'))
print('max ts',max(r[0] for r in rows),'monotonic', [r[0] for r in rows]==sorted(r[0] for r in rows))
ans={'error_count':1982,'top_error_code':'E408','checkout_mean_latency_ms':127,'timeout_unique_users':40,'first_fatal_ts':'2026-11-10T00:00:46Z'}
json.dump(ans,open('answers.json','w'),indent=2)
print(open('answers.json').read())
"
